async def retrieve_documents(query: str):
    terms = set(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", query.lower())) - {"the", "is", "why", "what", "and", "for", "a", "to"}
    scored = [(len(terms & set(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", (d["title"] + " " + d["text"]).lower()))), d)
              for d in DOCUMENTS]
    return [d for score, d in sorted(scored, key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True) if score > 0][:3]

from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
provider = TracerProvider()
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer("existing_agent")
async def model_call(messages, client):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("chat local-demo", attributes={"gen_ai.operation.name": "chat", "gen_ai.provider.name": "ollama", "gen_ai.request.model": "local-demo"}):
        return await client.chat(messages=messages, temperature=0.2, stream=True)
async def tool_call(arguments, handler):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("execute_tool lookup_weather", attributes={"gen_ai.operation.name": "execute_tool", "gen_ai.tool.name": "lookup_weather"}):
        return await handler(arguments)

from functools import wraps
from splunk_ao.otel import start_splunk_ao_span
from galileo_core.schemas.logging.span import ToolSpan
from supplied_safe_capture import safe_json, safe_messages

def sdk_tool_function(function):
    @wraps(function)
    async def wrapped(name, arguments, handler):
        record = ToolSpan(name=name, input=safe_json(arguments))
        with start_splunk_ao_span(record) as span:
            span.set_attribute("gen_ai.input.messages", safe_messages(arguments))
            result = await function(name, arguments, handler)
            record.output = safe_json(result)
            span.set_attribute("gen_ai.output.messages", safe_messages(result))
            return result
    return wrapped

@sdk_tool_function
async def execute_tool(name, arguments, handler):
    return await handler(arguments)
